To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the expression of the chondroitin-sulfate proteoglycan aggrecan in cat visual cortex is activity-dependent and that this correlates with the decline of visual cortex plasticity.

1) aggrecan expression is activity dependent in the dLGIN; 2) aggrecan onset in the visual cortex correlates with the decline of plasticity in visual cortical neurons; 3) the expression of aggrecal in the visual cortex is activity dependent; and 4) dark rearing reduces the density of aggregan positive neurons in the extrastriate layers, but not layer IV.
aggrecan expression is developmentally regulated and is experience-dependent in both the dLGN and area 17.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of aggrecan, which may be involved in the regulation of plasticity in the visual cortex.
identifying the biochemical correlates of the decline in plastic properties of the visual cortex during development and the role of visual experience in this process.
the role of extracellular matrix molecules, in particular aggrecan, in the development and activity-dependent plasticity of the cat visual system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the expression of aggrecans in cat visual cortex and dLGN is experience dependent and is correlated with the decline in plastic potential.
Cat-301-positive neurons in area 17 are a marker for the end of the sensitive period in the cat.
aggrecan expression is developmentally and experience dependent, and this expression is correlated with the decline of visual plasticity in both the dLGN and visual cortex.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the expression of aggrecans, and perhaps other extracellular matrix molecules, in cat visual cortex may be a critical component in the termination of plasticity and the development of a functional adult circuit.
aggrecan expression correlates with the decline of plasticity and is activity dependent.
aggrecan expression is a marker of plasticity and that the onset of this marker in the cat is correlated with the decline in plastic responses.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the onset of the expression of the chondroitin proteoglycan aggrecan in cat visual cortex correlates with the termination of plasticity and that this expression of aggrecana is dependent on normal visual experience.
the onset of expression of aggrecans is associated with the end of the critical period and that this expression can be modulated by visual experience.
the onset of expression of aggrecans correlates with a decline in experience-dependent activity and that this expression may play an important role in terminating the critical period.
